label: Deaths in armed conflicts, by location (UCDP best estimate)
source: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (2026), geoBoundaries, via Our World in Data
notes: Deaths by where they occurred, all UCDP conflict types (state-based, non-state, one-sided), best estimate. 2026 is a partial year. WLD is OWID's own world total; MEA and EUU are sums of member countries (MEA = World Bank region incl. Afghanistan and Pakistan). Starts 1989.
